verdict.rationale: The evidence only glancingly touches this story. The FAQ says users can 'keep track of all of their usage using our analytics', and the response-caching docs show that responses carry billable usage counters, which implies per-request token and cost accounting. Nothing in the pack describes inspecting logged request and response bodies, or latency attached to individual requests. Missing for 10: request/response log inspection, per-request latency metrics, a documented per-request cost and token view, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
